description: Use this when the user wants to change a capital call already made in one of their funds: its deadline or notes, or one investor’s amount. Starts the change. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed change, with each investor’s amount before and after and whether they are emailed, for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing, and Capital Company never moves money.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_update_capital_call
title: Change capital calls already made
